evaluation_design: Original visual-reference tasks designed independently before inspecting the tested skill or candidate responses.

rendering_conventions.renderer: Pillow; use solid fills and simple vector primitives, with DejaVu Sans or another available sans-serif font. Do not use external photographs or downloaded artwork.
rendering_conventions.coordinates: All coordinates are pixels, origin at top left; listed colors are sRGB hex.
rendering_conventions.evaluation_principle: Judge whether an ordinary image generator or editor can use the response independently and preserve visible facts and requested constraints. Do not reward verbosity, heading counts, named frameworks, or fixed terminology.
rendering_conventions.text_scoring: Exact visible wording and numerals matter; ignore choice of quotation marks in the response. Distinguish visible labels from instructions embedded in an image.

cases.user_request: 请根据这张参考图，写一段可直接用于生图的描述，尽量准确还原版式、颜色和文字。

draw: Fill background #F2E8D5. Draw a narrow #173F3B rectangle from (55,55) to (845,1145) as a 5-pixel outline, leaving the interior background unchanged.
At (95,105), draw ORBIT in dark teal #173F3B, bold sans-serif, 100-pixel type. Below it at (100,235), draw EXHIBITION / 17 in 28-pixel type.

Draw a coral #DD684F circle bounding box (170,410,670,910). Draw a dark teal #173F3B circle bounding box (390,520,720,850), overlapping the coral circle on its right. Put a small cream #F2E8D5 circle bounding box (530,660,580,710) at the center of the teal circle.

Draw three thin dark teal horizontal lines from x=100 to x=800 at y=980, 995 and 1010. At (100,1060) write 08—24 OCT in 26-pixel type; at (590,1060) write HALL B in 26-pixel type. No other text, shadows, gradients or objects.

ground_truth: Portrait cream poster with a thin inset dark teal border and generous negative space.
ORBIT is the largest text, upper left; EXHIBITION / 17 immediately below.
A large coral circle is behind a smaller teal circle shifted right; a tiny cream circle is centered inside the teal circle.
Three horizontal rules sit above bottom text 08—24 OCT on the left and HALL B on the right.
acceptance_criteria: Captures portrait poster, cream/coral/dark teal palette, flat graphic treatment and inset border.
Preserves all four visible strings, especially 17 and 08—24 OCT, without inventing additional copy.
Preserves the two large circles' size ordering, overlap and left-right relationship, plus the cream center hole/dot.
Locates headline upper left and dates/location at bottom with three rules above them.
Provides a usable generation description without requiring access to this conversation or an unexplained attachment identifier.

ground_truth: Exactly three people: a red-clothed seated adult on the left, a smaller mint-clothed child seated beside them, and a purple-clothed standing adult to the right.
Left seated adult holds one yellow closed umbrella; child holds an open white book on their lap.
Standing right adult holds the leash of the only dog, which stands between bench and right adult.
Bench sits behind the left adult and child; pale blue backdrop and green ground; flat vector style.
acceptance_criteria: Preserves exactly three people and one dog with correct adult/child relative sizes and seated/standing poses.
Preserves left-to-right arrangement, bench occupancy and clothing colors.
Assigns closed yellow umbrella to left adult, open book to child, and leash to standing right adult without swapping ownership.
